$comment: Same shapes as case-study/full. site.caseStudy.media is the layout the site sets in code for its case studies (the view's media prop), not a stored value: aside draws the featured image beside the parts it runs alongside (the challenge, the solution and the live-site link), which the view counts and writes as --salt-case-study-view-aside-rows; the measure is a default band's, var(--container-5xl). Two results draw data-columns 2.
summary: A case study in the aside layout: the featured image, as the priority image, beside a challenge, a solution and the live-site link, under a header with the client and two results; no back link, details, gallery or services.

courtyard.alt: A shaded courtyard of ferns and multi-stemmed birches beside the river

document.title: A courtyard by the river
document.challenge: A north-facing yard between two wings, in shade from October to March and used for bins.
document.solution: We paved it in reclaimed stone and planted for shade, so the restaurant could seat guests outside from spring.
